scholarships.name: SC/ST/PwD Tuition Fee Waiver
scholarships.eligibility: All regular SC, ST and PwD-category B.Tech and Dual Degree students admitted at IIT Bhubaneswar.
scholarships.benefit: Full waiver of the semester tuition fee (Rs 1,00,000 per semester); other semester dues such as hostel, mess and amenity charges still apply as for other students.

sources.title: Fee Structure for B.Tech. students, AY 2025-26 onwards — footnote on 100% tuition waiver for SC/ST/PwD students

scholarships.name: Family-Income-Based Tuition Fee Remission
scholarships.eligibility: GEN/EWS/OBC B.Tech and Dual Degree students whose family income is verified at or below Rs 5 lakh a year at the time of admission.
scholarships.benefit: Full waiver of the tuition fee for families earning under Rs 1 lakh a year; families earning between Rs 1-5 lakh a year get a two-thirds remission of the tuition fee.
